items.title: Neobanc: Pay Rent/Bills Using Credit Card For 2.75%, Earn 1% In Rewards + Credit Card
items.why: Card-funded rent is a fintech perk to watch; the 2.75% fee is steep against typical card rewards for cardholders.
items.summary_ai: Neobanc has launched in the US, letting people pay rent and bills by Visa or Mastercard for a 2.75% fee.
items.take: Card-funded rent is a fintech perk to watch; the 2.75% fee is steep against typical card rewards for cardholders.
